name: BCM Arya Cubing Challenge 2022

venue.name: BCM Arya Model Senior Secondary School
venue.address: BCM Arya Model Senior Secondary School, Ishmeet Singh Road, Shastri Nagar, Model Town, Ludhiana, Punjab 141002

information:
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and participants (except newcomers) might be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.

Stay inside the campus will not be possible, but there are multiple hotels at reasonable prices near the venue.

COVID-19 Specific Information:
* Wearing masks, Sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment orders is mandatory while attending the competition.
